def runsampleid(title, sampleid,  racktype, timetype, pos, limit):
    global pctotal, timetotal
    scantitle = 'runsample('+title + ', ' + str(sampleid) + ', ' + racktype + ', ' + timetype + ', ' + str(pos) + ', ' + str(limit) + ')'
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', scantitle )) 
    
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SMS:RunInfo:RunTitle', title))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:ITEMS', sampleid))

    if racktype == 'tumbler':
        print("...Set tumbler for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 1, completion=True))
    elif racktype == 'banjo':
        print("...Set banjo for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 2, completion=True))
    elif racktype == 'peltier':
        print("...Set peltier for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 3, completion=True))
    elif racktype == 'ti':
        print("...Set ti rack for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 4, completion=True))
    elif racktype == 'humid':
        print("...Set humidity cell for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 5, completion=True))
    elif racktype == 'furnace12':	
        print("...Set 12-pos furnace position for transX")
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:FillMenu', 6, completion=True))    
    else: 
        raise Exception("unknown sample environment type")        
    if pos > 0 :
        cmds.append(Set('BL6:Mot:SampleTable:Menu', pos, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:RunControl:Start', 1, completion=True))

    if timetype == 'pc' or timetype == 'PC':
        cmds.append(Wait('BL6:Det:PCharge:C', limit, comparison='increase by'))
        pctotal = pctotal + limit
    elif timetype.lower() == 'time':
        cmds.append(Wait('BL6:Det:N1:AcquireTimer_RBV', limit, comparison = 'increase by'))
        timetotal = timetotal + limit

    else:
        raise Exception("unknown time type")   
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:RunControl:Stop', 1, completion=True))

    id = submitsmart(cmds, scantitle)
    print(scantitle)
    newscan()

# reducescanrate_peltier
def reducescanrate_peltier():
    import epics

    # Define the PVs and their respective scan rates
    commands = [
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadMaxStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadMaxStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadLowestStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadLowestStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadHolderID.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadHolderID.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadStirrerSpeed.SCAN", "Passive"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadMaxTargetTemp.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadMaxTargetTemp.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadLowestTargetTemp.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadLowestTargetTemp.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadInstrumentStatus.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadInstrumentStatus.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadTempHolder.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadTempHolder.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadProbeTemperature.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadProbeTemperature.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadRampRate.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadRampRate.SCAN", "5 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadHighTempLimHeatExch.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadHighTempLimHeatExch.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC1:ReadHeatExchTemp.SCAN", "2 second"),
        ("BL6:SE:QNTC2:ReadHeatExchTemp.SCAN", "2 second"),
    ]

    # Loop over the commands and set each PV to the specified scan rate
    for pv, scan_rate in commands:
        result = epics.caput(pv, scan_rate)
        if result:
            print(f"Successfully set {pv} to {scan_rate}")
        else:
            print(f"Failed to set {pv} to {scan_rate}")

# runrobotid
def runrobotid(title, sampleid,  timetype, pos, limit):
    # DONOT USE THIS FUNCTION
    # THIS FUNCTION will be DELETED. 8/25/25
    global pctotal, timetotal
    scantitle = 'runrobotid('+title + ', ' + str(sampleid) + ', '  + timetype + ', ' + str(pos) + ', ' + str(limit) + ')'
    
    #CHECK existing call back value. 
    # if not 0,
    # return it first.
    # if 0, (assume sample not in the beam), proceed
    Set('BL6:SE:UR:CassetteNumber', 1, completion=True)
    If('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumCB', '>', 0, [ Set('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumCB', 0, completion=True) ])
    Submit(name='Check sample in beam then return')
    If('BL6:SE:UR:State', '=', 4, [Set('BL6:SE:UR:ClearError', 1)])
    Submit(name='check error')
    If('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumCB', '=', 0, [Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', 'CB = 0, proceeding.' , completion=True) ]) 
    Submit(name='Check sample in beam')
    
    #load cell
    # maybe add a check routine if the current value is not 0? then user need to double check.
    Set('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumCB', pos, completion=True)
    Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', 'robot picks up from position ' + str(pos) )
    Submit(name='Robot picks up sample from ' + str(pos))
    
    SetLog('log.setting runtitle','BL6:SMS:RunInfo:RunTitle', title)
    SetLog('log.setting items number','BL6:CS:ITEMS', sampleid, completion = True)
    #Delay(1) #for testing
    
    if timetype.lower() == 'pc' :
        Run(title, wait_pcharge_C=limit)
        pctotal = pctotal + limit
    elif timetype.lower() == 'time':
        Run(title, wait_seconds=limit)
        timetotal = timetotal + limit
    elif timetype.lower() == 'delay':
        Delay(limit)
    elif timetype.lower() == 'dummy':
        Run('NotSaving'+title, wait_seconds=0)
        Delay(limit)
            
    Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', scantitle )
    Submit(name=scantitle)
    
    #unload cell
    Set('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumCB', 0, completion=True)
    Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', 'robot returns from beam' )
    Submit(name='returns sample to pos ' + str(pos))
    print(scantitle)

# runrobotid2
def runrobotid2(title, sampleid,  timetype, pos, limit):
    global pctotal, timetotal
    scantitle = 'runrobotid('+title + ', ' + str(sampleid) + ', '  + timetype + ', ' + str(pos) + ', ' + str(limit) + ')'
    

    # load cell
    jobtitle = 'Loading sample pos '+str(pos)
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:CassetteNumber', 1, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumber', pos, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:PlaceSample', 1, completion=True))    
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', 'Loading sample pos '+str(pos) ))
    id = submitsmart(cmds, jobtitle)
    newscan()
    # Set info    

    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SMS:RunInfo:RunTitle', title, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:ITEMS', sampleid, completion=True))
    # collect neutron
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:RunControl:Start', 1, completion=True))
    if timetype == 'pc' or timetype == 'PC':
        cmds.append(Wait('BL6:Det:PCharge:C', limit, comparison='increase by'))
        pctotal = pctotal + limit
    elif timetype.lower() == 'time':
        cmds.append(Wait('BL6:Det:N1:AcquireTimer_RBV', limit, comparison = 'increase by'))
        timetotal = timetotal + limit
    else:
        raise Exception("unknown time type")   
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:RunControl:Stop', 1, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', scantitle))
    id = submitsmart(cmds, scantitle)
    newscan()
    
    # unload cell
    jobtitle = 'Unloading sample pos '+str(pos)
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:CassetteNumber', 1, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:SampleNumber', pos, completion=True))
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:SE:UR:ReturnSample', 1, completion=True))    
    cmds.append(Set('BL6:CS:LineLog:Add', 'Unloading sample to pos '+str(pos) ))
    id = submitsmart(cmds, jobtitle)
    print(scantitle)
    newscan()
